name: crypto-alts/xs-momentum-neutral
title: Regime-hedged betting-against-beta on liquid altcoins
description: Long the lowest-beta 30% and short the highest-beta 30% of a point-in-time universe of the 20 most liquid altcoins (EWM halflife-60 beta to BTC, equal weight within legs, daily targets averaged over 14 overlapping tranches). When BTC is above its 50-day SMA the legs are sized beta-neutral, which leaves the book net long dollars; below it they are sized dollar-neutral, which leaves the book with a negative beta and is what earns in BTC bear phases.
direction: long/short (dollar-neutral to net-long; never net short)

backtest.cost_type: taker + spread, charged on sum|dw| per side; short-leg funding/borrow NOT modelled

live_notes: SIM book: filled at the yfinance daily close from the shared data/ cache, with no order book, no rejection and no partial fill. Weaker evidence than a venue fill -- do not read this track as exchange-cleared. Binance spot cannot hold the short leg, so the venue book was never an option.

Cost: broker set to 10 bp fee + 0 bp slippage = the research's 10 bp/side on sum|dw| and nothing else. The report's ladder: 0 bp -> 1.26, 20 -> 1.18, 30 -> 1.14, so the book is not cost-sensitive. NOTE: live_lib.broker_from_meta (the dashboard's flatten button) rebuilds a basket with the 1 bp / 10 bp defaults = 11 bp/side; that affects a one-off flatten only, not the daemon.

BINDING RISK, unmodelled: short-leg funding/borrow. The backtest charges none. The report's sensitivity on short notional (~0.43 of NAV): 5%/yr -> Sharpe 1.13 full / 0.97 OOS; 10% -> 1.04 / 0.88; 20% -> 0.85 / 0.71. The spec says do not run this if funding on high-beta alts costs more than ~10%/yr. The sim book charges nothing for it, so the live equity curve will flatter a real one by that amount.

Borderline vs its 'Sharpe >= 1, winning in bear markets' brief, and the report says so: the spec config is 1.05 OOS but the 162-config grid median is 0.70 OOS (1.03 full), and universe size 20 was the best of four in an earlier screen. Read the OOS expectation as 0.7-1.05, not 1.05. Deflated Sharpe 0.90 at 50 effective trials, 0.63 at 1000.

Universe: the traded symbol list is FROZEN to the 62 candidates universe.load_panel served on 2026-09-17, which is exactly the panel 08_final.py backtested (ALTS minus the 14 Yahoo does not price: UNI, APT, SUI, MATIC/POL, FTM, GRT, COMP, STX, PEPE, IMX, TAO, TON, TRUMP). The ledger keys off this list -- changing it starts a fresh book, so do not edit it casually. Point-in-time membership rotates within the 62 (~13 names held, 20 eligible); the rest sit at weight 0.

Stalled-book failure mode: SimPortfolioBroker.bar_key is the MINIMUM bar across all 62 legs, so if Yahoo stops serving any one of them the whole book stops advancing and last_bar freezes -- visible in the log as 'bar X already traded' every day. The at-risk names are the near-dead ones carried as candidates: OMG-USD ($0.3M 90d median volume), XEM-USD ($0.2M), ONE-USD ($0.0M), all far below the $5M universe floor and so never actually held. If the book freezes, drop the stale ticker from TRADED (this restarts the ledger) rather than waiting.

Timing: yfinance publishes the current UTC day as a FORMING bar, so compute_weights drops every row dated on or after today (UTC) and decides on the last complete bar -- the research convention (weight at close t applies to the return of t+1, research_lib.backtest_xs). The daemon wakes once a day at 00:30 UTC, half an hour after the bar rolls, to give all 62 legs time to print. If a leg is later than that the book skips the day and self-corrects the next; with 14-day tranche averaging one skipped day is a small deviation.

Deploy check 2026-09-17: runner --check weight on the last complete bar (2026-09-16) equals alt_bab_weights recomputed over the same history to max|diff| = 0.0 -- gross 1.000, net +0.332, 13 legs (long DOT/TRX/XMR/LTC/BNB/XLM/FIL, short XRP/ADA/BCH/ZEC/AAVE/FET), BTC bull regime. weights_final.parquet stores the UNSHIFTED decision-at-close-t weight (lag 0; max|diff| exactly 0 over 3104 rows through 2026-09-05).

Survivorship: Yahoo serves no delisted coins, so LUNA/FTT-type collapses are absent from the backtest. Those would have been short-leg gains, so the bias runs against the strategy; dead low-beta names are likewise absent, which flatters the long leg.

Kill switches from the spec: if trailing 90-day realised Sharpe < -1.0, halve gross until it recovers above 0. If realised short-leg funding drag exceeds 15%/yr for a month, drop the strategy -- the edge does not survive that carry.

clean_close masks isolated >150% daily moves using the NEXT day's return (bad | bad.shift(-1)), so the live panel cannot mask a bad print on the newest closed bar the way the backtest could. It only ever fires on corrupt prints in names that are almost never in the top-20 universe; noted for completeness.
